fields.summary_ko.0: Micron (NASDAQ:MU) stock surged 16.5% Monday following news of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return, lifting AI stocks broadly.
fields.summary_ko.1: Expanded Nvidia GPU sales drive increased memory chip demand for Micron NAND and DRAM, with current stock trading at 8x P/E (undervalued).
